versions.changelog: SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized docs: richer features, FAQ, comparison table, geo/local section, accurate CLI quick-start; README badges. No code changes.

Major update with new features, commands, and improved documentation.

- Adds new commands for capability and permission introspection, JSON output, and self-testing.
- Introduces risk highlighting and improved CI integration.
- Overhauls documentation: new README, clearer usage instructions, detailed feature table.
- Removes outdated files and test suite.
- Now supports easier installation and works cross-platform with zero external dependencies.
